cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · Brent -3.02% · NatGas +12.31%. 58% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.04%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.04%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -1.77%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.54%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +13.42%, PWR +6.77%, EOSE +6.03%, ARRY +4.72%, NXT +3.84%. Laggards: ENPH -16.54%, SEDG -9.36%, BKR -6.27%, NOV -6.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.54% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
